Permission denied on the Docker socket. On the host, add your SSH user to the docker group (sudo usermod -aG docker <user>), then log out and back in — or connect as a user that is already in the docker group. Afterwards use \"Retest transport\" on this host.

The SSH server refused the unix-socket forward. Ensure sshd_config has BOTH AllowTcpForwarding yes AND AllowStreamLocalForwarding yes (AllowTcpForwarding no silently blocks socket forwards too), then restart sshd and use \"Retest transport\".
